lab_questions.title: Webhook Idempotency & Duplicate Charging
lab_questions.description: Evaluate a candidate's ability to handle asynchronous webhooks safely. The lab covers implementing idempotency checks, handling duplicate webhook retries, and enforcing database locks to prevent concurrent race conditions.

tasks.title: Enforce Webhook Idempotency
tasks.description:
The `POST /api/payments/webhook/` endpoint blindly credits the user's wallet. If the payment gateway retries the webhook due to network lag, the user is double-credited.

**Testing in Swagger UI:**
1. Open Swagger UI at `/swagger/`.
2. Send a POST request to `/api/payments/webhook/` with a payload.
3. Send the exact same payload again. It currently throws a 500 Server Error.

**Goal:** Implement an idempotency check using the `transaction_id`. If the webhook was already processed, the API must safely return `200 OK` (so the gateway stops retrying) but MUST NOT credit the wallet again. You must also implement database locking (`select_for_update`) to prevent concurrent race conditions from over-crediting the wallet.
